Session 7

Last we left off you all were preparing for a battle that was not confirmed to be but you all knew it was inevitable. After gaining some new allies and new weapons you all made your way out of the academy and to Valrich’s but first were interrupted by a familiar face. Stella shows up telling you all that she will help you in your coming fight. After speaking with his mother Valrich was told if he wanted answers to bring cargo to a far away city known as Yormindar. Next you went to Alberts Ales. Where Stu got kind of turned down but more so told to prove himself by the Orc woman he's been obsessing over. Upon leaving Alberts you were visited by Ceasar and were told that he was leaving to figure out something big. Then it was time your battle begins in the comfort of your own home you were attacked by a graveyard revenant, after almost losing some party members your fight was suddenly interrupted by a being named Verazanoth after showing off his immense power a fight between him and Caesar broke out. And so we pick up right where Ceasar threw his sword directly into Verazanoth the battle seemingly won.

At the beginning of the session the battle will seem to be over and Ceasar will be on one knee extremely tired from the fight and Stella will walk to the party and say 

Stella “Holy guys I was really worried about this but I’m glad we all made it out ali” and right as she is about to say alive an arrow from Obryn will shoot her in the neck killing her instantly.

As that happens the Raven Queen will appear behind Caesar and restrain him then point to Obryn and without uttering a word will say to Aralia in her head “Prove”

Then as they all look at Obryn they will see him with a cynical grin on his face. They will now be met face to face with the Vessel of Verazanoth. Then combat will begin in the middle of combat Kassian will show up

![](data:image/png;base64,)

After the fight when The Vessel leaves the party will have some time to talk amongst each other and converse with Caesar and their new found ally. 

Alivia will show up and undo the damage dealt to the landscape including their home.

Then Edwin will come to Aralia at night and will tell her about the plans that The Gifter has to steal a shipment of residum from a trade route between Volstar and Yormindar. He will say that they want the help of Umbra VI.

In the morning when Aralia tells the party of residuum Revilya will tell Valrich that this item is a key in discovering his sister's mystery. She will also say to him that she wants a private chat and will tell him to keep his eyes open on the road way for a friend of hers who will guide him to something as a reward for doing a good job in the fight.

If they decide to help Edwin he will join the party temporarily until the job is complete.

While on the road at night Valrich will see a pixie in the forest and it will lead him to a weirdly shaped tree (fey tree) the pixie will pass through the tree into a the feywild if Valrich passes in he will be transported to the feywild. 

As he enters I will give a description and sitting at a silver table with two chairs will be Revilya in her full form and a conversation will happen in the end Ravilya will gift a set of bracers to Valrich and tell him to make sure he brings her some residuum next time the meet like this.
